study: Dense-model control for GPTQ calibration-grouping reproducibility

model.offload: model_utils layer-wise (one decoder layer on GPU)

quantization.targets: mlp.gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj of the mapped layers; everything else BF16

calibration.strategy: FR s0 (random, B=128), the historical single-strategy comparison

metrics.primary: over the 5 groupings (ddof=1): SD(PPL), SD(log PPL), CV(PPL) = SD/mean
secondary: mean, min, max, max pairwise PPL difference
weights: GRA.weight_diff (identical definition to Family D) vs G20261111, 10 pairs, vs ORIGINAL
integer-code disagreement (solver info capture), separately from BF16 ULP
Hessians: frozen_routing.hessian_metrics (rel_fro_trace_normalized = historical Family D metric), act-order positions / group membership, diag-rank changes, damped-H conditioning

comparison.moe_reference: historical Qwen1.5-MoE FR s0 over the same 5 groupings (runs_multigroup_robustness; weights: runs_grouping_routing_amplification/logs/weight_differences_raw.json FR_s0 pairs)
comparison.ratios: R_PPL = SD_dense(log PPL) / SD_moe(log PPL); R_W = mean pairwise frac BF16 elements changed (dense / moe FR s0)
comparison.caveats: screening ratios, not tests; 5 groupings, 1 seed; F(4,4) 95% factor on an SD ratio is ~3.1x; architecture, size, matrix geometry, calibration statistics and baseline PPL are not matched

checks.A: BF16 dense checkpoint evaluated (PPL + per-window NLL); all parameters equal the checkpoint file
checks.B: every evaluation repeated in-process: per-window NLL bitwise identical; grouping G20261111 re-quantized in a fresh process from its cache: installed weights bitwise identical
checks.C: every grouping: identical union multiset, FR token sha, 128 x 512 tokens per projection Hessian, same layers; reversed batch execution order reproduces each cache bitwise
checks.D: every config: 12 target tensors expected shape, finite, all differ from BF16 original, non-targets unchanged, installed == bf16(solver output)
checks.E: each config starts from pristine targets (digest == checkpoint) - never from another grouping's weights
checks.F: after each config targets restored bitwise; non-targets unchanged; BF16 re-evaluation bitwise at end
